title: Keep sensitive values out of logs and error responses
summary: Logs, traces, telemetry, and client-facing error responses must not expose secrets, credentials, tokens, personal data, or internal security details.
review_checks: Find logging of request bodies, authorization headers, tokens, passwords, and exception internals.
Check error handling distinguishes client-safe messages from diagnostic logs.
safe_tests: Use synthetic sensitive markers in local tests.
Assert the marker is redacted from logs and responses.
remediation: Use structured allowlist logging with redaction.
Return generic client errors and retain constrained diagnostics for authorized operators.
